title: The Twin-Court Shield Canon
summary: A canon in which plate and blade are two courts of one guard that cover and answer each other with shared qi.

title: Treatise on the Azure Hawk's Plate
summary: A treatise on the plate held like a hovering hawk that stoops from above and folds behind its own shadow.

title: The Two-Track Plate Confluence
summary: A manual on keeping guard and strike on two qi tracks and joining them at the plate for a single decisive blow.

title: The Deep Basin Plate Canon
summary: A canon of pooling qi deep in the plate until it swallows blows and pours them back as one heavy stroke.

title: The Hawk-and-River Shield Canon
summary: A canon uniting the hawk's quick stoop with the river's long flow in one advanced method of the small shield.

title: Doctrine of the Azure Rim
summary: A doctrine of the bright qi-edged rim that guards first and cuts clean when the sky-wide cover is lifted.

title: The River Court Plate Mastery
summary: A mastery text of the open river court where the plate turns blows like a bank and strikes with the current.

title: The Wind-Sworn Oath Plate Course
summary: A course in which the plate is held in the stance of the oath and moves with the wind that was sworn to.

title: Treatise on the Plateau Rim Shield
summary: A treatise on fighting along the plateau's rim where a drop waits and the plate hardens like stone.

title: The Open Plateau Shield Manual
summary: A manual of the plate held on open ground with a wide qi sight and nothing behind it but the will to stand.

title: The Gale Bearing Plate Mastery
summary: A mastery text of a plate held on one fixed bearing from which a gale of qi is driven in a straight line.

title: The Open-Wind Shield Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of the light plate that lets the wind pass round it and strikes from the lee of a blow.

title: Treatise on the Oath-Kept Rim
summary: A treatise on the rim held as an oath is held and on the debts of blows that it returns.

title: The Long Wind Shield Canon
summary: A canon of the long coastal wind driven steadily from the plate to guard a column and sweep its front.
